summary: On September 9, 2026, Commerce.com (formerly BigCommerce) committed to a workforce-realignment plan revealed in this September 10, 2026 8-K, with roughly $4.2M-$8.8M of fiscal-Q3 charges and $4.3M-$17.5M more through completion by December 31, 2026. The same release announced a board-authorized $50M buyback effective September 10, 2026, expiring September 10, 2028. Charges will be excluded from non-GAAP metrics. No advisor, price, or premium is stated. Watch execution timing and whether buyback reduces share count or merely offsets dilution.
